mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM transactions WHERE occurred_at >= #{start} AND occurred_at < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM transactions WHERE occurred_at >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.enabled, u.created_at, COUNT(t.id) AS transaction_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ledgers l ON l.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.ledger_id = l.id GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.enabled, u.created_at ORDER BY u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.enabled, u.created_at, COUNT(t.id) AS transaction_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN ledgers l ON l.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.ledger_id = l.id WHERE u.id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, u.enabled, u.created_at

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, c.icon, c.builtin, u.username AS owner_username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.category_id = c.id) AS usage_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id ORDER BY c.builtin DESC, c.type, c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.type, c.icon, c.builtin, u.username AS owner_username, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.category_id = c.id) AS usage_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.id = #{id}
